Priority plan operations for navigating and managing priority plans.

This command group provides operations for working with priority plans:
  - current: View backlog items for the current priority plan
  - next: Navigate to the next priority plan
  - prev: Navigate to the previous priority plan
  - add: Associate a backlog item with a priority plan (child-owned)
  - remove: Clear priority plan association from a backlog item

  View backlog items for current priority plan
  zqk pplan current
  Add backlog item to priority plan
  zqk pplan add PLAN-123 ITEM-456
  Alternative positional syntax
  zqk pplan PLAN-123 add ITEM-456
  Remove backlog item from priority plan
  zqk pplan remove PLAN-123 ITEM-456

Usage:
  zqk object pplan [flags]
  zqk object pplan [command]

Available Commands:
  add         Add a backlog item to a priority plan
  current     View backlog items for the current priority plan
  next        Navigate to the next priority plan
  prev        Navigate to the previous priority plan
  remove      Remove a backlog item association from a priority plan

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk object pplan [command] --help" for more information about a command.
